pr_title: Fix issue causing the Android Editor port to crash when saving a scene
pr_body:
The issue was caused because we were not returning a valid ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND error when unable to find a file. 

In addition:
- Disable `adb devices` query (not supported when running the editor on Android devices)
- Add `move_to_trash` implementation for Android devices

Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/62488

issue_context.title: Can't Export or save a scene on Android
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

3.5 beta 3 (Android Version)

### System information

Android 8.1.0

### Issue description

I am using the **android** version of **Godot** Engine and I can't save my 3D scene, Every time I try to save it **crashes** and my work _wiped,_ I have tried to make a simple 2d game instead and yet again my work _wiped_ and the application ****crashes****.

### Steps to reproduce

Simple 3d scene, adding staticbody as the ground, and a simple cube with it's animation

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_

review_comments: Reading the Kotlin code I'm assuming you're doing it this way as you might add further negative error codes in the future, in which case it makes sense.
